question: How many Lok Sabha seats are allotted to the state of Goa as of General Election 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To fill the **17th Lok Sabha**, the **2019 general elections **are scheduled to take **place in India between April and May of that year**.
 
• There were **two constituencies**:
 
 
• **North Goa** 
 
 
• From BJP Shripad Naik was the candidate.
 
• From AAP Pradeep Padgaonkar was the candidate.
 
 
 
• **South Goa**
 
 
• From BJP Narendra Keshav Sawaikar was the candidate.
 
• From AAP Elvis Gomes was the candidate.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are a **sizable number **of **voters in India's general elections**.
 
• It is a **significant test **of the **democratic system of government**.
 
• There are **545 total seats **in the **Lok Sabha**.
 
• The **Election Commission **will hold elections to **fill 543 of these seats**.
 
• If the **President decides **that the **Anglo-Indian community **has not been **adequately represented**, persons from that **community are nominated **to fill the **remaining two seats**.
 
• 79 seats out of the **elective total are set aside for SC, and 41 for ST**.
